description: List the Loadster projects the current token can access, each with its id and name. Every other tool takes one of these ids. When the team has no projects, the result says so and points at create_project. Prefer an existing project: call list_projects first, and create a new one only if the team has none or the user explicitly asked for one. When unsure, ask the user before creating.
name: list_projects
title: List Projects
